Setup.Title: FFmpeg not found — CVP
Setup.Caption: FFmpeg not found
Setup.Head: FFmpeg libraries were not found
Setup.Intro: Without them the player cannot open a single file: both decoding and frame cache building rely on them. You can download a ready-made bundle (BtbN build, n7.1 win64 gpl shared) and put it next to the program.
Setup.Once: The download happens once: after that the player takes the libraries from this folder.
Setup.FailTail:
{0}
You can retry, or put the libraries into the folder by hand.

Settings.Title: Settings — CVP
Settings.Caption: Settings
Settings.GeneralHeader: G E N E R A L
Settings.LanguageHint: Another language is added by putting a Strings.<code>.json file into the Strings folder next to the program — following the English and Russian files already there.
Settings.Restore: Restore the last session at startup
Settings.RestoreHint: files, offset, segments and position. Clips opened from the command line win over the session.
Settings.Overlay: Overlay on the frame: file name, timecode, frame number (T)
Settings.Snap: Pull the playhead and segment handles to boundaries (S)
Settings.AutoPlay: Start playing as soon as a file is opened
Settings.AutoPlayHint: Applies to opening a file: from the dialog, by dropping and from the command line. A restored session stays paused — there you come back to the frame you left.
Settings.PauseOnSeekHint: A click on the ruler, dragging the playhead, Home/End and «to the segment start». Off — playback continues from the new position. Stepping by frames (arrows, wheel, shuttle) always pauses. The same checkbox is on the toolbar.
Settings.StartupHeader: V I E W   A T   S T A R T U P
Settings.StartupRemembered: As last time — the view from the restored session
Settings.StartupOnlyA: A only — one frame across the full width
Settings.StartupOnlyB: B only — one frame across the full width
Settings.StartupHint: The view also switches on the fly with the V key. The view picked here wins over the session: it is applied after the session is restored. A pair of files named together at startup still opens side by side — they were opened to be compared.
Settings.StepHeader: S T E P   A N D   S C R U B B I N G
Settings.WheelFrames: Big step of fast wheel scrolling, frames
Settings.WheelMs: Scrolling counts as fast if the clicks come faster than, ms
Settings.WheelHint: The wheel over the frame steps through the clip: slow turning — frame by frame, fast — straight to the big step. Ctrl+wheel is always frame by frame, Shift+wheel is always big. Over the timeline the wheel changes the zoom.
Settings.ShuttleHeader: S H U T T L E   L I M I T   (J / L)
Settings.CacheHeader: F R A M E   C A C H E
Settings.Threshold: Threshold: a step back slower than this builds the cache, ms
Settings.CacheFpsHeader: P R O X Y   F R A M E   R A T E
Settings.CacheFpsHint: Below the source rate the cache is smaller and builds faster, but frames are dropped and their numbers become the proxy's numbers.
Settings.AssocHeader: F I L E   T Y P E S
Settings.AssocHint: The program cannot make itself the default player: since Windows 10 that choice is made only in the system window. Registration adds CVP to «Open with» and to the list of applications you can pick there.
Settings.AssocUser: CVP is registered for video files for this user.
Settings.AssocMachine: CVP was registered by the installer for every user of this computer. Such a registration is removed by uninstalling the program.
Settings.AssocNone: CVP is not registered: it is not in the «Open with» menu.

Keys.Shuttle.What: shuttle: back · stop · forward (press again — twice as fast)

Keys.HomeEnd.What: start / end of the segment (with Shift — edges of the ruler)
Keys.InOut.What: segment start / end at the current frame
Keys.SegReset.What: reset the segment to the whole clip
Keys.Export.What: export the segment to a separate file
Keys.Offset.What: shift track B by a frame
Keys.Master.What: make the active track the master (the audio follows it)
Keys.Mute.What: turn the audio on or off
Keys.Layout.What: side by side / A only / B only (a view without its own clip is skipped)
Keys.Fullscreen.What: full screen (exit — Esc); a double click on the frame does the same
Keys.Scale.What: frame in its area: fit / fill / stretch
Keys.Compact.What: collapse the timeline to the progress bar
Keys.Open.What: open a file in track A (with Shift — in B)
Keys.SessionSave.What: save the session to a file
